judged_text: `EmbeddingController#update` is a no-op — it re-renders the serializer without persisting anything — and the paired client action `saveChanges()` calls `embedding.update({})`, so the PUT /customize/embedding route added in config/routes.rb is a dead endpoint on both sides. Any future contributor or plugin wiring a save button to saveChanges gets a success response with zero effect (silent data loss for the user); today it is ships-inert code — either delete the action/route or make update persist, since the current 'save' story is entirely per-host via EmbeddableHostsController.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds PUT /admin/customize/embedding (routes.rb) and a client action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` (admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6), but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders `EmbeddingSerializer` and does not persist any changes (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). This makes the endpoint effectively a no-op/placeholder and can mislead future wiring, although the current template (admin/templates/embedding.hbs) does not invoke `saveChanges()` so no user-facing broken save is shown in this diff.
